_comment: Golem Engine (Ardour 9.9, Linux): the plugin that plays each block type, by LV2 URI, VST3 class id (as Ardour's VST3 scanner reads it; golem/engine/run.sh scans before each start) or Ardour Lua DSP name. Read by bridge/engine/ardour_plan.py only (the REAPER path never reads it). Parameters are resolved like golem_rig.lua does: the catalog's parameter `name`, exact label first, then a case-insensitive substring of the Ardour label (labels measured on 2026-11-10: NAM 'Input Lvl', 'Output Lvl', 'Quality'; zeroconvolv 'Wet Signal Level'; Calf 'Time L', 'BPM', 'Feedback', 'Wet'; ACE 'Gain'). `files` = LV2 patch properties that carry a block's file (NAM model, IR). `loaded_output` = the plugin's output control that proves its file is loaded (> 0) when the plugin does not echo the file property back (sfizz: 'Number of regions', measured 2026-11-12); labels are read in the C locale (run.sh sets LC_ALL=C.UTF-8: sfizz's labels are translated otherwise). `drumkit` is two engine blocks: the translator (Lua DSP golem Drumtrans, port of golem_drumtrans.jsfx, its table written by the watcher) then the avldrums kit of the block's `kit_bank`; drumgizmo kits do not play here yet. `init` = values set ONCE when the plugin is added, before the block's parameters (golem_rig.lua FX_INIT: Calf chorus dry at unity, Surge XT Effects' FX Type). Proteus, Surge XT Effects, ZamGrains and Prisma are taken as VST3, as under REAPER: their LV2 builds expose no or other parameters (measured 2026-11-12, tools/check-engine-blocks.py). A parameter renamed by `params` drops the catalog's `map.scale` (golem_rig's rule for the OS tables): the table's plugin takes the catalog's unit. `absent` = catalog parameters with no control on this plugin, refused by the plan with the reason. Surge XT Effects (surge-spring, -freqshift, -treemonster) is out: its VST3 renames its controls after the FX type, the catalog's 'FX Parameter N' names do not resolve. `golem_fx` = the block is played by a golem-fx effect (the separate golem-fx repository, VST3: new sounds, not clones of REAPER's plugin; maintainer's decision 2026-11-12): tools/check-engine-parity.py reports its distance to the REAPER original for information, it does not fail on it. `status` (golem_fx entries) = `testing` while the maintainer tries the effect on the rig, `validated` once accepted; only validated entries are kept for a release. Plugins arrive through tools/golem-fx-install.py, which keeps a journal of what is installed (golem-fx commit, binary hash, date). A type absent from `effects` does not play on this engine yet (docs/ardour-plan.md §3: T1 blocks are added one by one in A3, T2 blocks come from golem-fx). `key` (golem_fx entries) = the plugin has a KEY input (a keyed gate: met, gate): the engine routes the lane's DI to it — REAPER: channels 3/4 of the track (golem_keytap on the input track, a pre-FX send elsewhere); Golem Engine: the insert's sidechain, connected to the card input (docs/golem-fx-sheet.md §4). `identity` (golem_fx entries) = the descriptor settings that ARE the block type when one golem-fx plugin plays several types (reverb-plate = algo Plate, reverb-room = algo Room, wah = model GCB-95): hidden from the sheet, never written by a block preset (docs/golem-fx-sheet.md §5).

absent.zone_lo: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet
absent.zone_hi: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet
absent.transpose: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet
absent.arp: a REAPER helper of golem_rig (note zone, transpose, arpeggiator), not on this engine yet

absent.pos: ZamGrains 4 has no Grain Position control (VST3 and LV2)

absent.channel: gfx-drive has no channel mode (it is mono first; a stereo lane gets it dual-mono)

absent.song_key: virtual: resolved by the compiler (Key and Scale follow the song)
